name: 43221 · Columbus, OH
findings: ZIP 43221 (Columbus) has 257 nonprofit organizations. 124 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 108 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (49% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43221 (Columbus) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
